title: TripInput
description: A Trip Atlas itinerary. The schema checks the shape of the file; `trip-atlas check` also checks references between fields, dates, timezones and totals.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so editors can validate and complete the file.

startDate.description: Dates day 1 as YYYY-MM-DD; otherwise days have numbers only.

timezone.description: IANA timezone fallback, such as Asia/Tokyo.

currency.description: One uppercase three-letter currency such as EUR for all per-person amounts, whose totals must stay finite; required once any price is set. Zero means free and omission means unknown.
currency.errorMessage: expected an uppercase ISO3 currency code, e.g. EUR

countries.description: Maps uppercase two-letter country codes to rates.

propertyNames.errorMessage: expected an uppercase ISO2 country code, e.g. JP

groups.description: Maps group IDs to named areas that simplify nearby places on the map.

places.description: Maps place IDs to places; may be empty.

days.description: At least one day, in order; {} continues the current location unless travelling overnight.

bookings.description: Reservations, kept separate from planned destinations.

price.description: Per person, in the trip currency.

mapUrl.description: A verified Google Maps link as https://maps.google.com/?cid=<number>. Never guess one.
mapUrl.errorMessage: expected an https Google Maps link

travelMode.title: TravelMode
travelMode.description: How you travel; `other` for anything else (cable car, rickshaw). On a journey, omit it when `components` give each part's mode; a line or service name belongs in `notes` only when you need it to catch the right one.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: A latitude/longitude pair: map placement for a place, the exact property location for a booking.

label.description: Names the link shown in the UI.

path.description: An existing local file relative to the itinerary folder, without absolute paths, URLs, traversal, backslashes, `:`, `%`, `?`, `#` or control characters. PDF, images, text and JSON open inline; other types download. Booking files live in documents/<country>/YYYY-MM-DD-<place>-<what>.pdf; the trip-atlas-download-booking skill fetches and names them.
path.errorMessage: expected a safe relative local path

name.description: Labels the place, defaulting to its ID.

country.description: An uppercase two-letter country code such as JP.
country.errorMessage: expected an uppercase ISO2 country code, e.g. JP

timezone.description: The place's IANA timezone for local travel times.

group.description: An existing group ID; does not change the underlying route.

livingPerDay.description: Daily estimate per person for food, drinks and small local rides, never tickets or tours; not charged on home days before the first night-stay country or after the last.

accommodationPerNight.description: Nightly accommodation share per person, excluding transit nights and the final day.

title.description: Briefly describes the day's purpose: "Fly Hanoi → Tokyo", "Day trip to Nara". Without one the viewer shows the route ("Hanoi → Cat Ba") or the stay ("Hanoi · Day 3").

notes.description: The day's one must-know that no booking, journey or activity owns; usually omitted.

occasions.description: What makes the date itself special, shown in full under the day title: "🎂 Ana's birthday", "Christmas Eve", "Last night in Japan". Not for plans; those are activities.

activities.description: What to see or do that day, in order.

blocks.description: Travel or place blocks in order; location carries forward afterward.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Something to see or do that day: a temple, a cruise, a show, a bath.

id.description: A unique stable reference for the booking that replaces its estimate.

name.description: The place's or experience's name as a traveller would search for it.

mapUrl.description: A verified Google Maps link: open the place's coordinates in Google Maps, find the listing among nearby places, and confirm name and address before converting its place ID (the 0x…:0x… pair; the second half, as a decimal, is the cid). Never guess one.

estimatedCost.description: Ticket, pass or tour price per person, counted under Activities; omit it for free activities.

components.errorMessage: omit mode when components give each part's mode

from.description: Overrides the origin, normally inferred from the current location.

id.description: A unique stable reference for booking costs.

endDay.description: The absolute 1-based arrival day, defaulting to the departure day; intervening days must have no blocks.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated minutes for the whole journey, without inventing clock times.

components.description: Mixed transport parts whose estimates are summed when no whole-journey estimate is supplied.

distanceKm.description: Route length in kilometres, mainly for walks.

place.description: The current place ID, without claiming a timed journey.

meal.description: true/false, or text for an included meal such as "18:00, Japanese"; an omitted meal is unknown.

type.description: `other` is a trip-wide expense (eSIM, visa) counted once in the whole-trip total.

title.description: Names the reservation; for a stay, the property name.

place.description: Its place ID; does not change the planned route.

startDate.description: The start or check-in date, independent of the trip's start date.

endDate.description: The end or checkout date; a hotel appears on checkout day without charging another night, and the Calendar lists it only on nights slept.

startDay.description: A 1-based trip day instead of calendar dates; the two cannot be mixed.

endDay.description: The last day or checkout day, after the start for accommodation.

status.description: Omission confirms nothing; cancellation excludes its cost.

meals.description: Meals with a stay, shown as dinner, breakfast, lunch; a text value is shown on hover. Put meal times and types here, not in notes.

checkIn.description: Local check-in time as HH:mm or a HH:mm-HH:mm window.

checkOut.description: Latest local check-out time as HH:mm.

baggage.description: Per-person bag allowances, e.g. on a flight.

notes.description: A plain-text reminder shown on the booking card, as a quiet tip by default.

important.description: true when the note is a must rather than a tip (e.g. "Bring ¥32,000 in cash"); the card then highlights it.

mapUrl.description: A verified Google Maps link to the place itself; the map pin opens it instead of the bare coordinates. Never invent one.

cost.description: The booking price, or a bare number as shorthand for { "amount": n }; omission keeps the existing estimates.

amount.description: The whole-booking price per person, not a nightly rate.

status.description: Defaults to estimated; independent of the reservation status.

allocation.description: Links the cost to estimates, each replaceable once; omission auto-matches hotels with a matching place and complete stay range, otherwise excluding the price from totals.

allocation.title: BookingAllocation
allocation.description: accommodation and transport need that booking type, activity and additional need an activity booking, other bookings take none, and unallocated excludes the price. No booking replaces the living budget.

nights.description: Unique 1-based days whose following nights are replaced equally. They must match the booking's complete check-in/checkout range and its place's overnight stays, and exclude transit nights and the final day.

leg.description: The travel block `id` whose estimate is replaced. It is also how a flight counts as booked: with "Show unbooked" on, the Calendar marks every flight without a non-planned, non-cancelled booking linked this way, so give booked flights' blocks an `id`.

activity.description: The planned activity `id` whose estimatedCost is replaced; the day card then marks it booked.

day.description: The day of an activity cost that no planned activity covers.

preparation.title: TripPreparation
preparation.description: The trip-wide checklist and packing list; the tab stays hidden without items.

checklist.description: Tasks in priority order, which supplies their displayed ranks even when completed.

packing.description: Items grouped by category in first-appearance order.

done.description: Defaults to false; editable only in the file.

packed.description: Defaults to false; editable only in the file.

quantity.description: A count; no quantity is assumed when omitted.
